note: A webhook payload that asks for the media id of Seerr with the placeholders media_id and id: Seerr leaves the text as it is, so only the TMDb and TVDb ids can reach a receiver. The request is what Seerr itself sent to the webhook address; the reply is the receiving container plain ok, not an answer from Deluno (Seerr 3.5.0 in Docker, linked to a Jellyfin; titles from TMDb through Seerr's own key).
